title: Not good quality at all…
text:
Not good quality at all…. [[VIDEOID:e1b1b99418b936c016e15988e90b8f75]] Not very good quality at all. All the knives are the cheapest I’ve felt. I would be afraid to cut into something with these as they may break at the handles. The holder is just complete junk plastic. The other utensils are nice. But, overall if this wasn’t free I would send it back.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
